name: Esulv

facts.text: Esulv is a level-47 named drakulv (Pack Drakulv faction) alone in the west of Malmohus (693,154/991,448); aggressive.
facts.source: runtime/data/opendaoc.sqlite3.db, Mob and NpcTemplate tables (0.37b world data)

facts.text: Esulv as the ash-wolf of the western camps is Living Server lore; the name's meaning is to verify.

story:
Esulv is the ash-wolf. The beam-cutters of Svarhamr read the name as ash and wolf, after the grey of the western camps where the drakulv burn what they do not eat, and the drakulv who holds it keeps those fires. He stands alone on the west side of the ruins, away from the patrols, and the smoke of the camps goes past him to the north, toward Skona, where the werewolves can smell it.

Brisa of Svarhamr says the western fires were lit after the werewolves' king refused the dragon, so that the varulv would know every night that the drakulv were still there. Esulv keeps them lit. He does not hunt with the others. He feeds the fires, and he fights all who come to put them out, which is to say all who come. The svartalfar cut his name on the beam with a mark beside it that means smoke.
legend: Esulv is a level 47 named drakulv alone in west Malmohus, near the western camps. Pack Drakulv faction, but nothing of his pack stands right next to him, so he's usually a clean pull. No spells. Good warm-up named for a group heading deeper into Malmohus. The western camps behind him are full of drakulv, so don't chase him into the smoke. Respawn is the usual named timer.

lairEntry: Smoke from the western camps. A drakulv keeps it.
